CFML Language Reference: Functions

TimeFormat

Returns the time part of a date/time value as a string, formatted according to a mask. If you leave out the mask, hh:mm tt is used.

Category

Display and formatting functions

Syntax

TimeFormat(time [, mask ])

Parameters

time
A date/time value or a string that can be converted to one, for example Now() or "4:30 PM".
mask
Characters that describe the format: h hours on a 12-hour clock without leading zero, hh with leading zero; H and HH the same on a 24-hour clock; m and mm minutes; s and ss seconds; t A or P, tt AM or PM. Other characters are copied to the result. You can also pass one of the named formats short (4:05 PM), medium or long (both 4:05:09 PM).

Returns

The formatted time as a string.

Usage

In a TimeFormat mask, m always means minutes; in a DateFormat mask it means the month. Remember which function you are in! LSTimeFormat formats times for the current locale.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET T = CreateDateTime(1999, 12, 31, 23, 59, 9)>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Mask</TH><TH>Result</TH></TR>
<TR><TD>(none)</TD><TD>#TimeFormat(T)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>HH:mm:ss</TD><TD>#TimeFormat(T, "HH:mm:ss")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>h:mm tt</TD><TD>#TimeFormat(T, "h:mm tt")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>h:mm t</TD><TD>#TimeFormat(T, "h:mm t")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>medium</TD><TD>#TimeFormat(T, "medium")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Right now</TD><TD>#TimeFormat(Now(), "hh:mm:ss tt")#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>
